title: Celebrating excellence: Unity Awards 2025 winners
summary: After a record 36,000 votes from global developer community, we announce the 2025 Unity Awards winners. Neva wins Best 2D Visual, Blue Prince takes Golden Cube.
body_markdown:
## The Unity Awards Showcase 2025


For the second year in a row, we announced the Unity Award winners during a live showcase. This event also highlighted updates and exclusives from Unity developers across our community. We featured recently released trailers from[Den of Wolves](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818140/Den_of_Wolves/) ,[Vampire Crawlers](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265700/Vampire_Crawlers_The_Turbo_Wildcard_from_Vampire_Survivors/) , and[Ferocious](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1645630/FEROCIOUS/) , along with first looks and developer insights – and even our very first world premiere. Here's a short recap of the games we featured during the show.


[Symbiosis](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874540/Symbiosis/)


Aberratic announced the demo for their hardcore base defense action RPG will release on January 26, 2026.


[The War of the Worlds: Siberia](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276190/The_War_of_the_Worlds_Siberia/)


1C Game Studios showcased new gameplay from their upcoming game, releasing in 2027.


[Planet of Lana II](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997230/Planet_of_Lana_II/)


We got an exclusive first look at new gameplay from Wishfully and Thunderful Publishing, with insight from the development team.


**Darkside Detective: The Backside of the Moon**


We had our very first world premiere, courtesy of Spooky Doorway and Akupara Games. In this reveal trailer, we got a first look at the new mind-melting mysteries that await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley.


[Sublustrum](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4151300/Sublustrum/)


Developers Brickworks Games gave us insight into the development of the remake of their classic 2008 psychological adventure.


[Nocturne](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374860/Nocturne/)


We enjoyed an exclusive look at new gameplay and insights from Pracy Studio.
